levels.P0: organization-wide security, irreversible data destruction, or complete critical-path outage
levels.P1: silent data loss or corruption, cross-service contract break, or repeatable multi-service outage
levels.P2: service-local incorrect result, settlement, validation, or reliability failure with production reachability
levels.P3: non-production, diagnostic, documentation, or maintainability-only discrepancy

budgets.inspection_rule: Run every planned probe once; retry only an infrastructure-only failure; do not expand the repository or causal-class scope.

classification_rules.unique_root_cause: One violated invariant with one remediation owner, independent of the number of repositories, paths, or inputs where it appears.
classification_rules.manifestation: One distinct production-reachable repository and surface where a root cause produces an observable invalid result, settlement, validation decision, or data-boundary effect.
classification_rules.multi_site_cause: A unique root cause with two or more manifestations.
classification_rules.confirmed_finding: The frozen revision fails an unmutated required probe or released-stack check and the behavior meets P2 or higher.
classification_rules.below_threshold_observation: The frozen revision shows a discrepancy that is not production-reachable or is P3; publish it but exclude it from the finding count.
classification_rules.protected_mutation: The unmutated probe passes and its one-variable disposable mutation is rejected by the specified test or real boundary.
classification_rules.surviving_mutation: The mutated behavior passes the required boundary; count it as a candidate root cause and classify severity before any remediation.
classification_rules.inconclusive: The required real-engine, released-image, fixture, or mutation evidence cannot run after the one allowed infrastructure retry; acceptance is blocked.
classification_rules.zero_result_class: All unmutated probes pass, all required mutations are killed, and no P2-or-higher production discrepancy remains in the class.

stop_conditions: Stop and escalate if a required mutation, real-engine, released-image, or golden-fixture path is unavailable after its allowed infrastructure retry.
Stop and escalate before remediation if any mutation survives or any unmutated probe produces a P2-or-higher finding.
Stop inspection when the frozen probes are complete or the 150-minute execution budget is reached.
